ValidationRule.description: A version only means something if it cannot change after the fact. Uses PRIORVALUE so the Draft-to-Published transition and the Published-to-Archived transition are both still allowed; only editing the body of an already-frozen version is blocked.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), "Published"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), "Archived") ), OR( ISCHANGED(System_Prompt__c), ISCHANGED(Goal__c), ISCHANGED(Version_Number__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This prompt version is already published and cannot be edited. Save a new version instead.
